description: This file defines functions and regex patterns related to parsing and handling release versions, such as extracting version components, comparing versions, and determining publish plans for npm. It appears to be a utility module for version management within a build or release system.

methods.name: parseDateParts
methods.description: Parses version string components and constructs a ParsedReleaseVersion object if valid.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into its components, returning a structured object or null if invalid.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings, returning -1, 0, 1 or null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the npm publish plan (channel, tags) based on the version and current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Resolves which authentication source to use based on provided tokens.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines if npm dist tag mirror authentication is required based on mode, tags, and auth presence.
